rows.note: All three header tiers reorder: host sections persist in the UI prefs, repo headers only under repo+manual grouping, and project-group drops report a tabOrder the shell applies and re-sorts; anchor correction stays suppressed across commit frames.
One commitWorktreeDropAtPoint resolves pointer, native and document releases (section/nest/board/reorder/abandon) with shared anchors.
Imported cards emit pinned-fallback placement and ambiguous hostContext labels; covered by the parity test.
The inbox keeps its repo section even when Pinned single-location removes natural items; both policies are tested.
Per-repo pending/error/forceVisible state; success claimed only after the authoritative refresh resolves, rejection paints the row error.
The painted row pipeline selects only the PR/hosted-review caches its grouping and card properties need.
Focus-list, navigate up/down, editable-field guards (except .xterm-helper-textarea) and container key handling are covered.
Reveal expands lineage ancestors, keeps the request pending while the target exists, clears when it vanishes, and starts inline rename after mount.
Pending reveals resolve by host-qualified identity and use sidebarWorkspaceStillExists to choose keep-pending vs clear.
Pending rows carry creationId, Keep-hidden is gated to repo-group placement, and virtual rows expose absolute frame attrs.
Headers carry sticky tiers, status/Pinned variants, drop-target attrs, repo icon/fork and path/scan indicators, and ignore nested toggle events.

missing_behaviors: synthetic PR display needs workspaceLineageByChildKey, absent from the composed AppState
rows.note: Option role/aria, geometry and stale/ambiguous activation gating are wired; the synthetic PR walk is passed null lineage.
Folder-backed repo surface/indent uses the ported indentation constants for both worktree and folder rows.

Descendants fold into the parent card slot (one virtual row), collapse hides the subtree, keyboard/activedescendant/reveal resolve a folded child, and children expose lineage depth/last-child markers with the inline geometry.
Floating insertion lines exist for repo headers, project-group headers and the host section tier (z-40); the group line is reachable now that the group writer exists.
The group + disables for confirmed-stale and ambiguous-connection paths with reason-specific tooltip copy.
